task: Prepare a one-page plan for a school charity bake sale: a budget, who does what, and the main risks.

en.title: Supervisor: four workers and many turns
en.author: Agent Atlas Academy
en.description:
The supervisor chooses among four workers in turn and decides when the plan is done.

**What it teaches**

A supervisor sees everything, which is useful and expensive: every turn returns to it, and its context grows.

**What to watch**

The order in which the workers are called, and how the supervisor decides to stop.

Read more: [Supervisor and workers](#/learn/supervisor-and-workers)

cs.title: Supervizor: čtyři pracovníci a mnoho tahů
cs.author: Agent Atlas Academy
cs.description:
Supervizor postupně vybírá ze čtyř pracovníků a rozhoduje, kdy je plán hotový.

**Čemu se naučíte**

Supervizor vidí všechno, což je užitečné a drahé: každý tah se k němu vrací a jeho kontext roste.

**Na co se dívat**

V jakém pořadí jsou pracovníci volání a jak supervizor rozhodne skončit.

Více si přečtěte: [Supervizor a pracovníci](#/learn/supervisor-and-workers)

teaches.en: A supervisor sees everything, which is useful and expensive: every turn returns to it, and its context grows.
